issues.where: the distant curved sea stacks and center horizon
issues.what: the stacks look smooth, sculpted, and clay-like with blurry vertical streaking and dark blotches instead of rugged, fractured coastal rock, and an unrequested vertical stone tower stands in the center distance
issues.fix: rebuild the sea stacks with fractured, layered rocky geometry and lichen/guano detail, and remove the vertical stone tower

issues.where: the sky, sunlight, and coastal horizon
issues.what: the lighting is flat overcast grey with none of the warm sunlight breaking onto the right-hand sea stacks or upper cliff, and the horizon is a calm lake-like edge without breaking white surf or sea mist
issues.fix: add directional warm sunlight from the upper right through broken storm clouds, along with breaking white ocean surf and misty spray at the base of the stacks

issues.where: the foreground tidal flat pebbles and shallow water (bottom-right of set-A-01-b.png)
issues.what: the gravel bed shows severe repeating diagonal and concentric hatched line artifacts over smeared grey lumps instead of crisp wet pebbles and sandbars
issues.fix: replace the hatched surface with clean, sharp wet pebbles, sandbars, shallow meandering water channels, and scattered brown seaweed

issues.what: the cliff is dry, jagged dark procedural rock topped by a smooth featureless grey wall, missing the dense wet olive-brown hanging kelp and layered pale upper rock with orange lichen
issues.fix: drape the lower cliff in wet, glossy olive-brown kelp fronds and give the upper cliff fractured, layered pale rock with orange lichen

issues.where: the cliff surface, kelp, and water runoff
issues.what: the cliff is dry striated grey-brown rock with only a few stiff ribbons on the left edge, missing the thick glossy kelp carpet, cascading water stream and droplets, and additional skeletons further along the cliff
issues.fix: cover the cliff in dense wet glistening kelp, add the trickling water stream and droplets on the left, and place additional bleached skeletons further back along the cliff

issues.where: the hanging carcass and crab-like scavengers (set-A-03-b.png)
issues.what: the carcass is dark muddy brown and flattened diagonally against the rock like clay with dark indistinct blobs for scavengers and a flat decal-like crab in the lower-left of the upper crop, rather than a pale vertical carcass with pale articulated scavengers
issues.fix: lighten the carcass to pale parchment-flesh tones with distinct hanging limbs and tendrils, and replace the dark blobs and decal with detailed, pale, three-dimensional crab-like scavengers

issues.where: depth of field and background separation
issues.what: the entire frame is in sharp focus from the foreground cliff to the distant sea stacks, flattening the shot, and the background repeats the smooth plastic stacks and extra vertical tower
issues.fix: add shallow optical depth of field to softly blur the tidal flat and distant sea stacks, and match the rugged rock detail and misty surf of the target

issues.where: the foreground and midground wading creatures
issues.what: the foreground creature is dark, matte, and wood-like with thick opaque wing ridges, stiff dark twig-like tentacles, and no prey or splash, instead of a pale fleshy creature with warm backlit translucent wing membranes catching a small pink prey in a lively splash
issues.fix: brighten and refine the skin texture, add warm orange-amber backlit translucency to the wing membranes, make the tentacles finer and fleshier, and add the caught prey with active water splashes and spray

issues.where: optical focus, foreground framing, and water surface
issues.what: there is no shallow depth of field so the distant stacks and bare striped foreground boulders are uniformly sharp, and the water looks like a flat glassy mirror with uniform concentric ripples instead of textured tidal shallows framed by blurred kelp-draped rocks
issues.fix: apply shallow telephoto depth of field to blur the kelp-covered foreground rocks and distant stacks, and break up the glassy water with organic shallows, wet sandbars, and natural splashes

issues.where: the water ripples and wing region (set-A-05-b.png)
issues.what: the upper crop shows artificial uniform concentric ripples with empty floating specks instead of a dynamic splash around caught prey, and the lower crop shows sharp flat background cliffs instead of the creature's detailed backlit translucent wing membrane
issues.fix: replace the uniform concentric ripples with dynamic splash geometry and droplets around the prey, and match the creature's scale, framing, and warm backlit translucent wing detail

issues.where: the wading creatures across the tidal flat
issues.what: the creatures are darker, stiffer, and lined up more evenly across the midground, and the far-right creature lacks the outstretched wings and taking-flight pose of the target
issues.fix: make the creatures paler and leaner with varied natural poses, including the far-right bird lifting off with wings spread

issues.where: the background landforms, surf, and sky
issues.what: the sky is flat uniform grey with no warm sunlight on the distant stacks, no breaking ocean surf or mist, and the unrequested vertical stone tower sits prominently in the upper center
issues.fix: remove the vertical tower, add dramatic storm clouds with warm sunlit highlights on the curved stacks, and restore breaking white surf and sea mist along the horizon
